<!--

===============================================================================

SAM Framework

Incident Report Template

===============================================================================



Purpose

-------

Use this template to document operational incidents that affected

the Framework, Modules, Services, AI behavior, or operational processes.



An Incident represents any deviation from expected operation.



Incidents exist to improve the Framework.



They are NOT documents for assigning blame.



The objective is organizational learning.



See:



\- PLAYBOOK\_TEMPLATE.md

\- KNOWLEDGE\_TEMPLATE.md

\- RESEARCH\_TEMPLATE.md

\- EXECUTION\_MODEL.md

\- RISK\_MODEL.md



===============================================================================

\-->

<!--

Author Checklist

----------------

\-->



# Author Checklist



\- \[ ] Timeline complete

\- \[ ] Root cause documented

\- \[ ] Evidence referenced

\- \[ ] Recovery documented

\- \[ ] Lessons identified

\- \[ ] Follow-up actions assigned

\- \[ ] Cross references validated



---



<!--

Common Mistakes

---------------

\-->



# Common Mistakes



\- Assigning blame instead of identifying causes.

\- Mixing assumptions with evidence.

\- Omitting the timeline.

\- Declaring root cause without proof.

\- Forgetting corrective actions.

\- Treating lessons learned as opinions.



---



<!--

Completion Checklist

--------------------

# Completion Checklist



\- \[ ] Metadata complete

\- \[ ] Evidence reviewed

\- \[ ] Review completed

\- \[ ] Corrective actions created

\- \[ ] Ready for repository publication

# Summary



Summarize:



\- what happened,

\- why it happened,

\- how it was resolved,

\- what the Framework learned,

\- and what should improve next.
